config.description: Lyney's Prop-Surplus stacks (ConditionStacks{name:'lyney_surplus_stacks', maxStacks:5}, Lyney.js:374-380) scale TWO outputs via her pure-×stacks getStackMultiplier (Multiplier.js:196-211 → CConst(min(settings[stacksLeveling] ?? 0, maxStacks)) pushed into the term's CMulti iff stacksLeveling set, 0 at 0 stacks). HEAL skill.lyney_hp_regeneration (FeatureHeal, one mult {scaling hp*, leveling char_skill_elemental, stacksLeveling lyney_surplus_stacks, values s2.p3=[20]}) → 0.20×hp_total×min(stacks,5)×(1+healing+healing_base+healing_recv) (Lyney.js:341-352). SKILL-DMG skill_dmg's 2nd mult lyney_skill_dmg_bonus (ATK-default, leveling char_skill_elemental, stacksLeveling lyney_surplus_stacks, values s2.p2=95.76% @talent10) → additive base-damage term +s2.p2%×atk_total×min(stacks,5) (Lyney.js:334-338). Stacks self-generate (Prop Surplus); 0 at solo → BASE lyney.json heal=0 + skill_dmg base-only. This config bakes lyney_surplus_stacks:5 (max) via mergeCharSettings (a SELF char toggle, the Furina/Yelan stacks-rep channel) → BOTH outputs non-zero, isolating both gaps. One new base-inert FeatureMultiplierEntry.stacksFactor closes both; lyneySurplusBurndown burns them RED until the engine field + the lyney.ts un-defers land, then the heal (=0 at the BASE stacks=0 fixture) flips outputCoverage's lyney row green (the 100%-green milestone).
